title: Donald As Mickey Mini Mean Bag The Disney Store Halloween Stuffed Toy
descriptionText: The Donald as Mickey Mini Mean Bag plush toy, available at The Disney Store, is a unique and collectible item perfect for Disney fans. This stuffed toy features Donald Duck dressed as Mickey Mouse, adding a fun and playful twist to the classic characters. Made in China, this officially licensed Disney product is a must-have for any fan of the beloved franchise.
